Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 7981 (Part IV)- 1976 




Indian Standard < Reaffirmed 1997 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
INSTRUMENTS, TUBOPLASTY 

PART IV PROBE, SINGLE ENDED, SHIRODKAR'S PATTERN 



1- Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements for Shirodkar's pattern single-ended probe 
used for tuboplasty in obstetrics. 



2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 



SERRATIONS 
ON BOTH SIDES

AH dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 PROBE, SINGLE ENDED, SHIRODKAR'S PATTERN 

2.1 A deviation of ± 2*5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

3. Materials — Shall be of stainless steel of Designation 04Cr18Ni10 or 07Cr18Ni9 of IS =6603-1972 

' Specification for stainless steel bars and flats '. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The probe shall be free from scales, pits burrs and other surface defects. 

4.2 The tip of the probe shall be bulbous and smooth. 

4.3 All edges shall be smoothly rounded off. 

4.4 The probe shall be polished bright and passivated. 

5. Tests 

5.1 Flexibility Test — Taking the proximal end of the probe between the fingers and thumb of one 
hand, the distal end shall be gradually bent with the other hand, so that, on completion of the 
process, the tip shall be at a distance of approximately 30 mm from the base line. The probe shall 
then be straightened. The process of bending and straightening shall be repeated six times. During 
or on completion of the test the probe shall not break or split. 

5.2 Corrosion Resistance Test — Scrub the probe with soap and warm water, rinse in hot water 
and then dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the sample. Immerse in copper sulphate solution at

be permitted. 

6. Marking — Mark with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) The words ' Stainless Steel \ 

6.1 AS/ Certification Marking —Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing -The probe shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or packed in polyethylene bags. 
The probes shall then be packed in individual cartons.
